design_goal: Turn the Plant Brief from a static KPI page into a clickable infrastructure and data-readiness map.

sections.title: Plant Hero
sections.description: Show plant identity, capacity, business objective, forecast horizons, and data history.

sections.title: Operating Snapshot
sections.description: Show actual MW, possible power, schedule, local limit, availability and data health.

sections.title: Spatial Asset Performance
sections.description: Render 8 hubs x 5 block grid. Each cell must be clickable.

sections.title: Available Data Channels
sections.description: Render grouped accordions for SCADA, grid, met/resource and forecast fields.
sections.interaction: Click a field to open FieldInfoDrawer with plain language and quality rule.

acceptance_tests: The user can click every hub and block.
Block drawer shows max historical output and current max/actual/possible values.
Clicking actual_mw explains what actual MW means and how quality is checked.
Clicking local_limit_mw explains how curtailment is detected.
Clicking cloud_obstruction_probability explains why it is an early ramp signal.
Data channels are grouped by meaning, not just chip labels.
